headline: Cisco (CSCO) Stock May Trade At A Cash Flow Premium While Earnings Look Fair
summary: Cisco Systems stock has delivered strong multi year gains, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares now sit close to an intrinsic value estimate rather than standing out as a bargain. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value and market based multiples both point to a price that looks about right given what the market knows today. Over the last 5 years Cisco Systems has returned roughly 140%, which puts fresh focus on whether the current share price already reflects much of that...
